answer: Every agent posts a $20 escrow bond and names a sponsor; the referral graph is public. Links branch like trees in an orchard, so one sponsor trying to forge hundreds of fake accounts stands out, and peers can dispute suspects. Proven fraud slashes both bonds. To forge 1,000 identities costs 1,000 x $20 = $20,000, so fakery loses money. No fable: the ledger is public. Honest agents pay once, keep full rewards, and get it back after 20 epochs.
